analysis_code:
# XRR Parratt fit using refnx.
# Inputs in scope:
#   result     — dict from proc_code (theta, intensity, ...)
#   params     — merged: schema defaults → saved module_config → workspace overrides.
#                Includes layer_{i}_{prop}, buffer_{i}_{prop}, substrate_{prop}.
#                params['__fixed__'] = list of param ids the user marked fixed.
#   bounds     — per-field {min, max} from the workspace.
#   layers     — sample.layers list (deposition order: layers[0] = first deposited / bottom)
#   substrate  — sample.substrate (string; material name)
#   get_material, list_materials — resource API
import numpy as np
from refnx.reflect import SLD, ReflectModel
from refnx.dataset import ReflectDataset
from refnx.analysis import Objective, Transform, CurveFitter

# ── Atomic data (Z, molar mass) — covers common perovskite/oxide elements ──
ATOMIC = {
    'H':(1,1.008),'Li':(3,6.94),'B':(5,10.81),'C':(6,12.01),'N':(7,14.01),
    'O':(8,16.00),'F':(9,19.00),'Na':(11,22.99),'Mg':(12,24.31),'Al':(13,26.98),
    'Si':(14,28.09),'P':(15,30.97),'S':(16,32.07),'Cl':(17,35.45),'K':(19,39.10),
    'Ca':(20,40.08),'Sc':(21,44.96),'Ti':(22,47.87),'V':(23,50.94),'Cr':(24,52.00),
    'Mn':(25,54.94),'Fe':(26,55.85),'Co':(27,58.93),'Ni':(28,58.69),'Cu':(29,63.55),
    'Zn':(30,65.38),'Ga':(31,69.72),'Ge':(32,72.63),'Sr':(38,87.62),'Y':(39,88.91),
    'Zr':(40,91.22),'Nb':(41,92.91),'Mo':(42,95.95),'Ru':(44,101.07),'Rh':(45,102.91),
    'Pd':(46,106.42),'Ag':(47,107.87),'Sn':(50,118.71),'Sb':(51,121.76),'Cs':(55,132.91),
    'Ba':(56,137.33),'La':(57,138.91),'Ce':(58,140.12),'Nd':(60,144.24),'Sm':(62,150.36),
    'Eu':(63,151.96),'Gd':(64,157.25),'Tb':(65,158.93),'Dy':(66,162.50),'Ho':(67,164.93),
    'Er':(68,167.26),'Yb':(70,173.05),'Lu':(71,174.97),'Hf':(72,178.49),'Ta':(73,180.95),
    'W':(74,183.84),'Re':(75,186.21),'Os':(76,190.23),'Ir':(77,192.22),'Pt':(78,195.08),
    'Au':(79,196.97),'Pb':(82,207.2),'Bi':(83,208.98),
}

def sld_from_chem(comp, density):
    '''X-ray SLD in 10⁻⁶ Å⁻². f ≈ Z (valid far from absorption edges).'''
    if not comp or not density: return 0.0
    z = sum(ATOMIC.get(e, (0, 0))[0] * float(n) for e, n in comp.items())
    m = sum(ATOMIC.get(e, (0, 0))[1] * float(n) for e, n in comp.items())
    if m == 0: return 0.0
    return float(density) * 6.022e23 * 2.818e-13 * z / m * 1e-10

# Index materials by name once
_mat_by_name = {}
for _mid in list_materials():
    _m = get_material(_mid)
    if _m: _mat_by_name[_m.get('name', '')] = _m

def material_for(name):
    return _mat_by_name.get(name or '')

# ── Data preparation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theta_arr = np.asarray(result['theta'], dtype=float)
intensity = np.asarray(result['intensity'], dtype=float)
wavelength = float(params.get('wavelength_aa', 1.5406) or 1.5406)

tmin = float(params.get('theta_min', 0.1) or 0.1)
tmax = float(params.get('theta_max', 5.0) or 5.0)
mask = (theta_arr >= tmin) & (theta_arr <= tmax) & (intensity > 0)
if mask.sum() < 10:
    raise ValueError(f'Too few data points in fit window ({mask.sum()})')

theta_fit = theta_arr[mask]
i_fit = intensity[mask]
q_fit = 4 * np.pi / wavelength * np.sin(np.radians(theta_fit / 2))

# Normalize to total external reflection plateau (max intensity)
i_max = float(np.max(i_fit))
i_norm = i_fit / i_max

fixed_ids = set(params.get('__fixed__') or [])
fittable = {}        # param_id → refnx Parameter (for value readback)
density_aux = {}     # param_id → sld_per_unit_density (for back-conversion)
top_sld_obj = None   # SLD object of the topmost layer (for θ_c readback)

def get_bounds(key, fallback_min, fallback_max):
    b = (bounds or {}).get(key) or {}
    lo = b.get('min', fallback_min)
    hi = b.get('max', fallback_max)
    if lo is None: lo = fallback_min
    if hi is None: hi = fallback_max
    return float(lo), float(hi)

# NOTE: refnx slab thickness and roughness are in Å. Our config uses nm.
# Multiply nm → Å on the way in; divide Å → nm on the way out.
NM_TO_AA = 10.0

def build_slab(key, mat_name, *, has_thickness, t_default):
    global top_sld_obj
    mat  = material_for(mat_name)
    comp = (mat or {}).get('composition') or {}
    rho_default = ((mat or {}).get('properties') or {}).get('density_g_cm3')
    rho = float(params.get(f'{key}_density', rho_default) or rho_default or 5.0)
    rough_nm = float(params.get(f'{key}_roughness', 0.5) or 0.0)
    sld_val = sld_from_chem(comp, rho)

    sld_obj = SLD(sld_val)
    if has_thickness:
        thick_nm = float(params.get(f'{key}_thickness', t_default) or t_default)
        slab = sld_obj(thick_nm * NM_TO_AA, rough_nm * NM_TO_AA)
        if f'{key}_thickness' not in fixed_ids:
            t_lo, t_hi = get_bounds(f'{key}_thickness', max(0.5, thick_nm * 0.5), thick_nm * 2.0)
            slab.thick.setp(vary=True, bounds=(t_lo * NM_TO_AA, t_hi * NM_TO_AA))
            fittable[f'{key}_thickness'] = slab.thick
            density_aux[f'{key}_thickness'] = NM_TO_AA  # divide on readback
    else:
        slab = sld_obj(0, rough_nm * NM_TO_AA)

    if f'{key}_roughness' not in fixed_ids:
        r_lo, r_hi = get_bounds(f'{key}_roughness', 0.0, 2.0)
        slab.rough.setp(vary=True, bounds=(r_lo * NM_TO_AA, r_hi * NM_TO_AA))
        fittable[f'{key}_roughness'] = slab.rough
        density_aux[f'{key}_roughness'] = NM_TO_AA

    if f'{key}_density' not in fixed_ids and comp:
        sld_per_unit = sld_from_chem(comp, 1.0)
        if sld_per_unit > 0:
            d_lo, d_hi = get_bounds(f'{key}_density', max(0.1, rho - 0.5), rho + 0.5)
            sld_lo, sld_hi = sld_per_unit * d_lo, sld_per_unit * d_hi
            sld_obj.real.setp(vary=True, bounds=(sld_lo, sld_hi))
            fittable[f'{key}_density'] = sld_obj.real
            density_aux[f'{key}_density'] = sld_per_unit
    return slab, sld_obj

# ── Build slab list in refnx top-to-bottom order ──────────────────────────
slab_list = []
sld_objs  = []   # parallel list of SLD objects (for θ_c on top layer)
n_layers = len(layers)
for i in range(n_layers - 1, -1, -1):
    layer = layers[i] or {}
    target = ((layer.get('targets') or [{}])[0]) or {}
    mat_name = target.get('material') or ''
    t_default = float(layer.get('thickness_nm') or 50)
    slab, sld_obj = build_slab(f'layer_{i}', mat_name, has_thickness=True, t_default=t_default)
    slab_list.append(slab)
    sld_objs.append(sld_obj)

# Substrate buffers
sub_mat = material_for(substrate)
sub_stack = ((sub_mat or {}).get('properties') or {}).get('substrate_stack') or []
bulk_name = substrate
for i, buf in enumerate(sub_stack):
    if buf.get('thickness_nm') is None:
        bulk_name = buf.get('material') or substrate
    else:
        bn = buf.get('material') or ''
        slab, sld_obj = build_slab(
            f'buffer_{i}', bn, has_thickness=True,
            t_default=float(buf.get('thickness_nm') or 5),
        )
        slab_list.append(slab)
        sld_objs.append(sld_obj)

# Bulk substrate
sub_slab, _ = build_slab('substrate', bulk_name, has_thickness=False, t_default=0)
slab_list.append(sub_slab)

# Top SLD object is the first (topmost) — for θ_c reporting
top_sld_obj = sld_objs[0] if sld_objs else None

# ── Build refnx structure: ambient | layers (top-down) | substrate ─────────
ambient = SLD(0)(0, 0)
structure = ambient
for s in slab_list:
    structure = structure | s

# Resolution: dq is constant ΔQ/Q in % (refnx convention)
dq_pct = float(params.get('dq_pct', 4.0) or 4.0)

# Scale and background — fittable
scale_init = float(params.get('scale', 1.0) or 1.0)
bkg_init   = float(params.get('bkg', 1e-7) or 1e-7)

model = ReflectModel(structure, bkg=bkg_init, scale=scale_init, dq=dq_pct)

if 'scale' not in fixed_ids:
    s_lo, s_hi = get_bounds('scale', 0.5, 2.0)
    model.scale.setp(vary=True, bounds=(s_lo, s_hi))
    fittable['scale'] = model.scale
if 'bkg' not in fixed_ids:
    b_lo, b_hi = get_bounds('bkg', 1e-10, 1e-4)
    model.bkg.setp(vary=True, bounds=(b_lo, b_hi))
    fittable['bkg'] = model.bkg

dataset = ReflectDataset((q_fit, i_norm))
objective = Objective(model, dataset, transform=Transform('logY'))

# ── Two-stage fit: DE for global, least_squares for local refinement ──────
if len(fittable) > 0:
    fitter = CurveFitter(objective)
    fitter.fit('differential_evolution', popsize=20, maxiter=120, tol=0.001, seed=1)
    try:
        fitter.fit('least_squares')
    except Exception:
        pass  # LM may fail at bounds; keep DE result

# ── Build fit curve at all measurement points ─────────────────────────────
q_full = 4 * np.pi / wavelength * np.sin(np.radians(np.maximum(theta_arr, 1e-6) / 2))
fit_r = model(q_full)
fit_y = (fit_r * i_max).tolist()

# ── θ_c (calculated, in 2θ degrees) from top-layer SLD ────────────────────
two_theta_c = None
if top_sld_obj is not None:
    top_sld = float(top_sld_obj.real.value)  # in 10⁻⁶ Å⁻²
    if top_sld > 0:
        sld_a2 = top_sld * 1e-6  # convert to Å⁻²
        theta_c_rad = wavelength * np.sqrt(sld_a2 / np.pi)
        two_theta_c = float(np.degrees(theta_c_rad) * 2)

# ── Extract fitted values ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit_out = {}
for key, param_obj in fittable.items():
    v = float(param_obj.value)
    if key in density_aux:
        v = v / density_aux[key]
    fit_out[key] = v

# Metrics
chi2 = float(objective.chisqr())
log_obs = np.log10(np.clip(i_norm, 1e-12, None))
log_calc = np.log10(np.clip(model(q_fit), 1e-12, None))
rmse_log = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((log_obs - log_calc) ** 2)))

return {
    '_overlay_traces': [
        {'x': theta_arr.tolist(), 'y': fit_y,
         'label': 'Fit', 'style': 'fit', 'axis': 'y1', 'color': '#2dd4bf'}
    ],
    '_fit_params': fit_out,
    'chi2':        chi2,
    'rmse_log':    rmse_log,
    'two_theta_c': two_theta_c,
    'n_points':    int(mask.sum()),
    'n_free':      len(fittable),
}
